verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is a developer terminal for iOS, so committing and pushing from the device is a fair question for this kind of product. However, its documented local commands (cat, grep, ls, cp, mv, etc.) and its file-transfer tools (scp, sftp, curl) do not include git. Running git over SSH/Mosh on a remote server, or through connected VS Code/Codespaces, would be a host-platform or user-side workaround, not a Blink capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can commit and push changes directly from my device
